problem.title: How to convert a genome-scale model in .json format into an SBML/MATLAB file (.xml/.mat format)
problem.description: I have a genome-scale metabolic model (a.k.a. GEM) made by other people who are not a part of my lab, and I would like to use it. The problem: it is in the .json format, and I need it to be in the .xml (or .mat) format. How can I convert it?
